limits: Bounded mature-library reference contracts and concrete source recipes; no universal framework/device/AT certification.
Canonical HTML/CSS fixtures are reusable domain projections. Actual behavior comes from separately bound pinned React/primitive adapters.
Figma measurements, hashes, native specimen inventory and inverse mappings are retained only as dedicated evidence.
Calendar attached-ref repair, source API quirks and deliberate caller composition remain explicit; pinned upstream source bytes are unchanged.
